notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check that callback-service entry points reject re-entry while a FederateAmbassador callback is executing. The source uses only the official C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, endpoint, and callback configuration. It does not assert provider-specific names, registries, headers, or FOM behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador evokeCallback and evokeMultipleCallbacks during FederateAmbassador callback delivery
